summary: Sialkot sourcing with Malik/Shanco only (no AliTra or other second manufacturer); samples and feedback; initiated logo and stick graphics design.
annual_report: Engaged with field hockey stick manufacturer Malik/Shanco and an agent in Sialkot, Pakistan, where most high-quality sticks worldwide are manufactured
Obtained product samples from the manufacturer and provided feedback on specifications and quality
Initiated new graphics design for the Corporation’s logo and field hockey stick product artwork (work in progress)
quarterly_graphics_design_note: The Sole Director also reported that new **graphics design** for the Corporation’s **logo** and **stick** product artwork was **in progress** during the quarter.
quarterly_business_review: During **{quarter} {year}**, the Sole Director reviewed the Corporation’s **field hockey stick** activities: engagement with stick manufacturer **Malik/Shanco** and an agent in **Sialkot, Pakistan** (where most high-quality sticks worldwide are manufactured), including obtaining **samples** and providing **manufacturer feedback**. The Sole Director confirmed that **product designs**, **manufacturing specifications**, **branding**, **website content**, and related **intellectual property** developed for the Corporation under supplier and consultant arrangements **are properly titled to and are the exclusive property of the Corporation**; **suppliers’ and consultants’ facilities, equipment, and personnel are not owned by the Corporation**.
quarterly_ratification_resolution: RESOLVED, that all **manufacturer and agent engagements**, **sample review**, **product design**, and related **intellectual property** completed during the quarter are hereby ratified, confirmed, and approved as assets of the Corporation.
